inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

row.name: Home Sweet Home in Home Childcare Facility

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregiver had NationalCPRFoundation training which is a complete online course and does not utilize in person training with a manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: It was observed that screen time was being utilized during a mealtime. This was corrected when the primary caregiver turned off the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: One school age child in care was missing school information and contact number in their file. This information was corrected by parent permission during pick up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §747.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Training Hours: Training records for the primary and assistant caregiver were not made available for review during the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §747.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Upon arrival to the home, it was observed that children of the ages 3months to 3 years old were engaged in screen time. This was corrected when the screen was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: It was observed that cleaning supplies and hair chemicals were found to be accessible to children under the bathroom cabinets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outside play area had broken pieces of glass and tile on the ground. The fence was not in good repair and contained broken wood and exposed nails.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: The outdoor a/c unit in the back of the home did not have a safeguard or barrier around it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One child's file did not contain release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's files did not contain health statement information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. Daily sign in and out logs for all days in the month of June were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): A pre-employment affidavit was not on file for the assistant caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate: The children were watching a televison show rated "PG" which means parental guidance. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Definition of Assistant Caregiver: An assistant caregiver was left alone caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Definition of Assistant Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1203(a))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): An assistant caregiver, hired on 6/2/25, did not have a notarized affidavit available for review in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The permit holder admitted that an individual was present and in the presence of children without having a completed initial background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: Based on the information obtained, the logs show that there were 13 children clocked in and present at the same time. In addition, there were 3 other children who was not clocked in but were also present with the other 13 children in care. A photo also shows there were 14 children present in one room together.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: Based on the information provided, a photo shows a total of 4 infants with 10 other children who were at least 18 months and over with one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Based on the information provided, there is a video that shows a 5 year old, placed in a high chair as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2705(10))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: During the inspection, the sign out sheet for the children that were not enrolled into NCI, was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information provided, a photo shows 2 infants left alone a room. One infant was placed in a car seat on the bed and the other infant was sitting in a play pin. Due to the proximity of the room of where the infants were placed, a caregiver would not be able intervene and ensure proper supervision is maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The parents of the two infants have not completed written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: Toddler children and children up to 4 years old are being required to remain in time out for up to 5 minutes which over the one minute per year requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §747.2703(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were uncovered outlets in areas used by the children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal: Documentation of current CPR and First Aid training for the primary caregiver was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal (26 TAC §747.1327(c)(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the four children's records evaluated the following information was missing:  Three children were behind with immunizations.  One child's record lacked an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Of the four children's records evaluated, two lacked health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: One room being used by children is not equipped with smoke detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: The home is not equipped with a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)
